spans.s:
Kauṇṭha-ravya is mentioned as a teacher in the aitareya and śāṅkhāyana Āraṇyakas.
Foot notes iii. 2, 2.
vii. 14; viii. 2.
Cf. Keith, aitareya Āraṇyaka, 249.

Kauṇḍinya is mentioned as a pupil of śāṇḍilya in the first two Vaṃśas (lists of teachers) in the Bṛhadāraṇyaka upaniṣad. See also Vidarbhīkauṇḍinya, and the following.
Foot notes ii. 5, 20; iv. 5, 26 (Mādhyaṃdina = ii. 6, 1; iv. 6, 1, kāṇva).

Kauṇḍinyāyana is mentioned in the first vaṃśa (list of teachers) of the Mādhyaṃdina recension of the Bṛhadāraṇyaka upaniṣad as a pupil of kauṇḍinya, pupil of kauṇḍinya and āgniveśya; in the second as a pupil of the two Kauṇḍinyas, pupil of kauṇḍinya and āgniveśya. Neither vaṃśa is of much value.
Foot notes ii. 5, 20.
iv. 5, 26.
Eggeling, Sacred Books of the East, 12, xxxiv.
